content:
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(scales)

if (FALSE) {
  library(munsell); library(farver); library(labeling)
  library(colorspace); library(RColorBrewer); library(viridisLite)
  library(isoband); library(gtable); library(withr)
  library(R6); library(rlang); library(vctrs); library(lifecycle)
  library(cli); library(glue); library(magrittr); library(tibble)
  library(pillar); library(tidyselect); library(generics)
  library(htmltools); library(htmlwidgets); library(jsonlite)
  library(crosstalk); library(jquerylib); library(sass)
  library(cachem); library(memoise); library(fastmap); library(base64enc)
  library(digest); library(mime); library(promises); library(later)
  library(stringr); library(stringi); library(purrr); library(cpp11)
}


source("global.R")


#======================================================================
# UI
#======================================================================


ui <- page_navbar(
  id      = "nav",
  title   = span(strong(APP$title),
                 span(APP$subtitle, class = "app-subtitle d-none d-xl-inline")),
  # preset = "bootstrap" and an explicit system font stack keep the app
  # fully self-contained: bslib's default preset pulls a font from Google
  # Fonts at page load, which breaks offline use and shinylive.
  theme   = bs_theme(version = 5, preset = "bootstrap",
                     bg = "#fcfcfb", fg = "#1c1b19",
                     primary = "#1F4E5F", "navbar-bg" = "#ffffff",
                     base_font    = font_collection("system-ui", "-apple-system",
                                                    "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue",
                                                    "Arial", "sans-serif"),
                     heading_font = font_collection("system-ui", "-apple-system",
                                                    "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue",
                                                    "Arial", "sans-serif")),
  header  = tagList(
    tags$head(tags$style(HTML("
      .app-subtitle{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:400;color:#86817a;margin-left:.7rem}
      .dataset-strip{background:#fcfcfb;border-bottom:1px solid #e3e1dd}
      .dataset-strip .form-group{margin-bottom:0}
      .dataset-strip .form-check-label{font-size:.83rem;color:#54514c}
      .card{border-color:#e3e1dd}
      .card-header{background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid #efedea;
        font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#86817a}
      .flag{font-size:.72rem;border:1px solid #e3e1dd;border-radius:5px;
        padding:2px 9px;color:#54514c;background:#fcfcfb;margin-right:6px;
        display:inline-block;margin-bottom:5px}
      .flag.good{border-color:#9ec9a8;background:#f0f8f2;color:#2b6b3c}
      .flag.warn{border-color:#e0c48a;background:#fdf7ea;color:#7a5a12}
      .gene-title{font-style:italic;font-weight:600;font-size:1.6rem;margin:0}
      .kv{font-size:.86rem} .kv dt{color:#86817a;font-weight:400}
      .kv dd{margin-bottom:.35rem}
      table.dataTable td, table.dataTable th{font-size:.84rem}
      .note{font-size:.78rem;color:#86817a}
      .warnbox{border:1px solid #e0c48a;background:#fdf9f0;border-radius:6px;
        padding:12px 14px;font-size:.86rem;color:#6b5312}
    ")))
  ),
  
  # TAB 1 ─ Browse ------------------------
  nav_panel(
    "Browse the landscape",
    layout_sidebar(
      sidebar = sidebar(
        width = 320, title = "Filters",
        
        checkboxGroupInput("f_age", "ILAE age-of-onset category",
                           choices  = AGE_LEVELS,
                           selected = AGE_LEVELS[1:4]),
        checkboxGroupInput("f_sig", "Clinical significance",
                           choices  = SIG_LEVELS,
                           selected = c("P/LP", "VUS","B/LB"), inline = TRUE),
        selectInput("f_validity", "ClinGen gene–disease validity",
                    choices = c("Any", VALIDITY_CHOICES), selected = "Any"),
        textInput("f_gene", "Gene symbol contains", placeholder = "e.g. SCN"),
        textInput("f_term", "Mondo term contains", placeholder = "e.g. myoclonic"),
        
        accordion(
          open = FALSE,
          accordion_panel(
            "More filters",
            selectInput("f_vartype", "Variant type",
                        choices = c("Any", VARTYPE_CHOICES), selected = "Any"),
            selectInput("f_conseq", "Molecular consequence",
                        choices = c("Any", CONSEQUENCE_CHOICES), selected = "Any"),
            selectInput("f_pathway", "Functional pathway",
                        choices = c("Any", PATHWAY_CHOICES), selected = "Any"),
            selectInput("f_list", "Gene list",
                        choices = c("All genes", "Consensus set",
                                    "genes4epilepsy (Oliver 2023)",
                                    "Macnee 2023",
                                    if (isTRUE(app_meta$has_ilae_list))
                                      "Named in the ILAE classification"),
                        selected = "All genes"),
            selectInput("f_constraint", "gnomAD constraint",
                        choices = c("Any",
                                    sort(unique(na.omit(gene_meta$lof_constraint)))),
                        selected = "Any"),
            sliderInput("f_year", "Submission year",
                        min = YEAR_RANGE[1], max = YEAR_RANGE[2],
                        value = YEAR_RANGE, step = 1, sep = "")
          )
        ),
        actionButton("reset", "Reset filters", class = "btn-sm btn-outline-secondary"),
        downloadButton("dl", "Download table (.csv)", class = "btn-sm")
      ),
      
      layout_columns(
        fill = FALSE, col_widths = c(3, 3, 3, 3),
        value_box("Genes",          textOutput("kpi_genes"),   theme = "primary"),
        value_box("Submissions",    textOutput("kpi_subs"),    theme = "primary"),
        value_box("Mondo terms",    textOutput("kpi_terms"),   theme = "primary"),
        value_box("P/LP share",     textOutput("kpi_plp"),     theme = "primary")
      ),
      
      layout_columns(
        col_widths = c(7, 5),
        card(card_header("Top genes by variant submissions"),
             plotOutput("p_top", height = "380px"),
             div(class = "note px-3 pb-2",
                 "Click a row in the table below to open a gene profile.")),
        card(card_header("Composition of the filtered set"),
             plotOutput("p_comp", height = "170px"),
             plotOutput("p_genes", height = "170px"))
      ),
      
      card(card_header(textOutput("tbl_caption")),
           DTOutput("tbl_genes"))
    )
  ),
  
  # TAB 2 ─ Gene ------------------------ 
  nav_panel(
    "Gene search",
    div(
      class = "container-fluid p-3",
      layout_columns(
        fill = FALSE, col_widths = c(4, 8),
        selectizeInput("gene_sel", "Gene symbol", choices = NULL, width = "100%"),
        div()
      ),
      # Every row on this tab uses the SAME col_widths = c(7, 5), which is
      # what makes the card edges line up down the page. Cards in one
      # layout_columns row also stretch to a common height automatically.
      layout_columns(
        col_widths = c(7, 5),
        uiOutput("gene_header"),
        card(card_header("Submissions by clinical significance"),
             plotOutput("g_sig", height = "70px"),
             uiOutput("g_sig_tbl"))
      ),
      layout_columns(
        col_widths = c(7, 5),
        card(card_header("Mondo phenotypes annotated to this gene"),
             DTOutput("g_terms"),
             div(class = "note px-3 pb-2",
                 "Age category is a property of the Mondo term, not of the gene — ",
                 "which is why a gene can appear under more than one category.")),
        card(card_header("Submissions over time"),
             plotOutput("g_year", height = "230px"),
             uiOutput("g_links"))
      )
    )
  ),
  
  # TAB 3 ─ Phenotype ------------------------
  nav_panel(
    "Phenotype search",
    div(
      class = "container-fluid p-3",
      layout_columns(
        fill = FALSE, col_widths = c(7, 3, 2),
        selectizeInput("term_sel", "Mondo term", choices = NULL, width = "100%"),
        if (HAS_EDGES)
          radioButtons("term_roll", "Descendant terms",
                       c("This term only" = "no", "Roll up children" = "yes"),
                       inline = TRUE)
        else div(class = "note pt-4",
                 "Descendant roll-up is available once app_data/edges.rds exists."),
        div()
      ),
      uiOutput("pheno_header"),
      card(card_header("Genes annotated to this phenotype"),
           DTOutput("p_genes_tbl"),
           div(class = "note px-3 pb-2", "Click a row to open that gene's profile."))
    )
  ),
  
  # ── TAB 4 ── About ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  nav_panel("About", div(class = "container p-4", uiOutput("about"))),
  
  nav_spacer(),
  nav_item(span(class = "navbar-text small text-muted",
                HTML(paste0(APP$version, " · Mondo ",
                            app_meta$mondo_version))))
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  SERVER
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # ── Populate the two big dropdowns on the server. With thousands of
  #    choices this is much faster than sending them all to the browser.
  updateSelectizeInput(session, "gene_sel",
                       choices = sort(gene_meta$Gene),
                       selected = gene_meta$Gene[1], server = TRUE)
  updateSelectizeInput(session, "term_sel",
                       choices = TERM_CHOICES,
                       selected = TERM_CHOICES[1], server = TRUE)
  
  # LEVEL 1 REACTIVE: the dataset the whole app is showing ------------------------

  dataset <- reactive({
    d <- submission_counts
    if (isTRUE(input$drop_conflicting)) d <- d %>% filter(!conflicting)
    if (isTRUE(input$clingen_only))     d <- d %>% filter(clingen_supported %in% TRUE)
    if (isTRUE(input$drop_bulk))        d <- d %>% filter(!bulk_upload)
    d
  })
  
  output$dataset_n <- renderText({
    d <- dataset()
    # ASCII separators only: dynamic text is rendered by R, and a
    # non-UTF-8 locale on the serving machine mangles typographic
    # characters here (the static UI text is fine, it is HTML).
    paste0(n_fmt(sum(d$n)), " submissions  |  ",
           n_fmt(n_distinct(d$Gene)), " genes  |  ",
           n_fmt(n_distinct(d$MondoID)), " Mondo terms")
  })
  
  #  LEVEL 2 REACTIVE: the Browse tab's filters on top of that ------------------------
  filtered <- reactive({
    d <- dataset()
    
    if (length(input$f_age)) d <- d %>% filter(age_cat %in% input$f_age)
    if (length(input$f_sig)) d <- d %>% filter(significance %in% input$f_sig)
    if (!identical(input$f_validity, "Any"))
      d <- d %>% filter(clingen_validity == input$f_validity)
    if (!identical(input$f_vartype %||% "Any", "Any"))
      d <- d %>% filter(Vartype_grouped == input$f_vartype)
    if (!identical(input$f_conseq %||% "Any", "Any"))
      d <- d %>% filter(consequence_class == input$f_conseq)
    if (nzchar(input$f_gene %||% ""))
      d <- d %>% filter(grepl(input$f_gene, Gene, ignore.case = TRUE))
    if (nzchar(input$f_term %||% "")) {
      hits <- term_meta$MondoID[grepl(input$f_term, term_meta$term_label,
                                      ignore.case = TRUE)]
      d <- d %>% filter(MondoID %in% hits)
    }
    yr <- input$f_year %||% YEAR_RANGE
    d <- d %>% filter(SubmissionYear >= yr[1], SubmissionYear <= yr[2])
    
    # gene-level filters need a lookup into gene_meta
    keep <- gene_meta$Gene
    if (!identical(input$f_pathway %||% "Any", "Any"))
      keep <- intersect(keep, gene_meta$Gene[gene_meta$pathway %in% input$f_pathway])
    if (!identical(input$f_constraint %||% "Any", "Any"))
      keep <- intersect(keep, gene_meta$Gene[gene_meta$lof_constraint %in% input$f_constraint])
    keep <- switch(input$f_list %||% "All genes",
                   "Consensus set"                    = intersect(keep, gene_meta$Gene[gene_meta$in_consensus]),
                   "genes4epilepsy (Oliver 2023)"     = intersect(keep, gene_meta$Gene[gene_meta$in_g4e]),
                   "Macnee 2023"                      = intersect(keep, gene_meta$Gene[gene_meta$in_macnee]),
                   "Named in the ILAE classification" = intersect(keep, gene_meta$Gene[gene_meta$in_ilae %in% TRUE]),
                   keep)
    d %>% filter(Gene %in% keep)
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$reset, {
    updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "f_age", selected = AGE_LEVELS[1:3])
    updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "f_sig", selected = c("P/LP", "VUS"))
    for (i in c("f_validity", "f_vartype", "f_conseq", "f_pathway", "f_constraint"))
      updateSelectInput(session, i, selected = "Any")
    updateSelectInput(session, "f_list", selected = "All genes")
    updateTextInput(session, "f_gene", value = "")
    updateTextInput(session, "f_term", value = "")
    updateSliderInput(session, "f_year", value = YEAR_RANGE)
  })
  
  #  Browse: KPIs ------------------------
  output$kpi_genes <- renderText(n_fmt(n_distinct(filtered()$Gene)))
  output$kpi_subs  <- renderText(n_fmt(sum(filtered()$n)))
  output$kpi_terms <- renderText(n_fmt(n_distinct(filtered()$MondoID)))
  output$kpi_plp   <- renderText({
    d <- filtered()
    if (!sum(d$n)) return("—")
    pct(sum(d$n[d$significance == "P/LP"]) / sum(d$n))
  })
  
  # Browse: gene-level table behind both the table and the bar chart ─
  gene_summary <- reactive({
    d <- filtered()
    if (!nrow(d)) return(NULL)
    d %>%
      group_by(Gene) %>%
      summarise(
        Total = sum(n),
        `P/LP` = sum(n[significance == "P/LP"]),
        VUS    = sum(n[significance == "VUS"]),
        `B/LB` = sum(n[significance == "B/LB"]),
        `Mondo terms` = n_distinct(MondoID),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      left_join(gene_meta %>% select(Gene, primary_age_cat, clingen_validity,
                                     pathway, in_ilae),
                by = "Gene") %>%
      arrange(desc(Total))
  })
  
  output$p_top <- renderPlot({
    d <- filtered(); validate(need(nrow(d) > 0, "No submissions match these filters."))
    top <- gene_summary() %>% slice_head(n = 15) %>% pull(Gene)
    d %>%
      filter(Gene %in% top) %>%
      group_by(Gene, age_cat) %>% summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(Gene = factor(Gene, levels = rev(top))) %>%
      ggplot(aes(n, Gene, fill = age_cat)) +
      geom_col(width = .68) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = AGE_COLS, drop = FALSE) +
      scale_x_continuous(labels = label_comma(),
                         expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .06))) +
      labs(x = "Number of variant submissions", y = NULL) +
      theme_epi()
  })
  
  output$p_comp <- renderPlot({
    d <- filtered(); validate(need(nrow(d) > 0, ""))
    d %>%
      group_by(age_cat, significance) %>% summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
      group_by(age_cat) %>% mutate(p = n / sum(n)) %>% ungroup() %>%
      ggplot(aes(p, fct_rev_safe(age_cat), fill = significance)) +
      geom_col(width = .62) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = SIG_COLS, drop = FALSE) +
      scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                         expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .02))) +
      labs(x = "Share of submissions", y = NULL) +
      theme_epi(11) + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "plain"))
  })
  
  output$p_genes <- renderPlot({
    d <- filtered(); validate(need(nrow(d) > 0, ""))
    d %>%
      group_by(age_cat) %>% summarise(g = n_distinct(Gene), .groups = "drop") %>%
      ggplot(aes(g, fct_rev_safe(age_cat), fill = age_cat)) +
      geom_col(width = .58) +
      geom_text(aes(label = g), hjust = -0.25, size = 3.4, colour = INK$muted) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = AGE_COLS, drop = FALSE, guide = "none") +
      scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .12))) +
      labs(x = "Genes", y = NULL) +
      theme_epi(11) + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "plain"))
  })
  
  output$tbl_caption <- renderText({
    g <- gene_summary()
    paste0("Filtered genes: ", if (is.null(g)) 0 else nrow(g), " rows")
  })
  
  output$tbl_genes <- renderDT({
    g <- gene_summary()
    validate(need(!is.null(g), "No genes match these filters."))
    out <- g %>%
      transmute(Gene,
                `Age category` = age_pill(primary_age_cat),
                Total, `P/LP`, VUS, `B/LB`, `Mondo terms`,
                `ClinGen validity` = clingen_validity,
                Pathway = pathway)
    epi_table(out, escape = FALSE) %>%
      formatCurrency(c("Total", "P/LP", "VUS", "B/LB"), "", digits = 0)
  })
  
  output$dl <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() paste0("epilepsy_clinvar_filtered_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
    content  = function(file) write.csv(gene_summary(), file, row.names = FALSE)
  )
  
  # Clicking a gene row jumps to the Gene tab ------------------------
  observeEvent(input$tbl_genes_rows_selected, {
    g <- gene_summary()$Gene[input$tbl_genes_rows_selected]
    updateSelectizeInput(session, "gene_sel", selected = g, server = TRUE,
                         choices = sort(gene_meta$Gene))
    nav_select("nav", "Gene search")
  })
  
  # GENE TAB ------------------------------------------------
  gene_rows <- reactive({
    req(input$gene_sel)
    dataset() %>% filter(Gene == input$gene_sel)
  })
  gene_row <- reactive({
    req(input$gene_sel)
    gene_meta %>% filter(Gene == input$gene_sel)
  })
  
  output$gene_header <- renderUI({
    m <- gene_row(); req(nrow(m) == 1)
    flag <- function(cond, txt, cls = "good")
      if (isTRUE(cond)) span(class = paste("flag", cls), txt) else NULL
    card(
      div(class = "d-flex justify-content-between flex-wrap gap-3 p-3",
          div(
            p(class = "gene-title", m$Gene),
            div(class = "note mb-2",
                paste0("chr", m$chromosome %||% "?", "  |  ",
                       m$pathway %||% "pathway not assigned")),
            div(
              flag(isTRUE(m$in_ilae), "Named in the ILAE classification"),
              flag(identical(m$clingen_validity, "Definitive"), "ClinGen: Definitive"),
              flag(isTRUE(m$in_consensus), "Consensus gene set"),
              flag(n_distinct(gene_rows()$age_cat) > 1,
                   "Annotated to more than one age category", "warn")
            )
          ),
          tags$dl(class = "kv",
                  tags$dt("Primary age category"),
                  tags$dd(HTML(age_pill(m$primary_age_cat))),
                  tags$dt("ClinGen validity"), tags$dd(m$clingen_validity %||% "—"),
                  tags$dt("ClinGen asserted disease"), tags$dd(m$clingen_disease %||% "—"),
                  tags$dt("Mondo terms"), tags$dd(m$n_terms),
                  tags$dt("First submission"), tags$dd(m$first_year)
          )
      )
    )
  })
  
  gene_sig <- reactive({
    gene_rows() %>%
      group_by(significance) %>% summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
      complete(significance, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
      mutate(p = n / sum(n))
  })
  
  output$g_sig <- renderPlot({
    s <- gene_sig(); validate(need(sum(s$n) > 0, "No submissions."))
    ggplot(s, aes(x = p, y = "", fill = significance)) +
      geom_col(width = .5) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = SIG_COLS, drop = FALSE) +
      scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
      theme_void(base_size = 11) +
      theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank())
  })
  
  output$g_sig_tbl <- renderUI({
    s <- gene_sig()
    tags$table(class = "table table-sm mb-0", style = "font-size:.85rem",
               lapply(seq_len(nrow(s)), function(i) tags$tr(
                 tags$td(span(style = sprintf(
                   "display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:2px;background:%s;margin-right:7px",
                   SIG_COLS[as.character(s$significance[i])])), as.character(s$significance[i])),
                 tags$td(class = "text-end", n_fmt(s$n[i])),
                 tags$td(class = "text-end text-muted", pct(s$p[i]))
               ))
    )
  })
  
  output$g_constraint <- renderUI({
    m <- gene_row(); req(nrow(m) == 1)
    num <- function(x, d = 2) if (is.na(x)) "—" else formatC(as.numeric(x), format = "f", digits = d)
    tags$dl(class = "kv p-3 mb-0",
            tags$dt("LOEUF"),      tags$dd(paste0(num(m$oe_lof_upper), " — ",
                                                  m$lof_constraint %||% "no data")),
            tags$dt("pLI"),        tags$dd(num(m$pLI)),
            tags$dt("Missense z"), tags$dd(paste0(num(m$mis_z), " — ",
                                                  m$mis_constraint %||% "no data"))
    )
  })
  
  output$g_trials <- renderUI({
    m <- gene_row(); req(nrow(m) == 1)
    tags$dl(class = "kv p-3 mb-0",
            tags$dt("Registered interventional studies"),
            tags$dd(m$n_trials_total %||% "—"),
            tags$dt("Recruiting"), tags$dd(m$n_trials_recruiting %||% "—"),
            tags$dt("In genes4epilepsy"), tags$dd(if (isTRUE(m$in_g4e)) "yes" else "no"),
            tags$dt("In Macnee 2023"),    tags$dd(if (isTRUE(m$in_macnee)) "yes" else "no")
    )
  })
  
  output$g_terms <- renderDT({
    d <- gene_rows(); validate(need(nrow(d) > 0, "No submissions for this gene."))
    out <- d %>%
      group_by(MondoID, age_cat) %>%
      summarise(Total = sum(n),
                `P/LP` = sum(n[significance == "P/LP"]), .groups = "drop") %>%
      left_join(term_meta %>% select(MondoID, term_label), by = "MondoID") %>%
      arrange(desc(Total)) %>%
      transmute(`Mondo term` = term_label, ID = MondoID,
                `ILAE category` = age_pill(age_cat), `P/LP`, Total)
    epi_table(out, selection = "none", page = 8, escape = FALSE)
  })
  
  output$g_year <- renderPlot({
    d <- gene_rows(); validate(need(nrow(d) > 0, ""))
    cat1 <- as.character(gene_row()$primary_age_cat)
    d %>%
      group_by(SubmissionYear) %>% summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
      ggplot(aes(SubmissionYear, n)) +
      geom_col(width = .7, fill = AGE_COLS[cat1] %||% "#8E44AD") +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .08))) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(6)) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Submissions") +
      theme_epi(11) +
      theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = INK$line, linewidth = .3),
            axis.text.y = element_text(face = "plain"))
  })
  
  output$g_links <- renderUI({
    g <- req(input$gene_sel)
    a_ <- function(lbl, url) tags$a(lbl, href = url, target = "_blank",
                                    class = "me-3 small")
    div(class = "px-3 pb-3",
        a_("ClinVar",  paste0("https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/clinvar/?term=", g, "%5Bgene%5D")),
        a_("gnomAD",   paste0("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/gene/", g)),
        a_("ClinGen",  paste0("https://search.clinicalgenome.org/kb/genes?search=", g)),
        a_("OMIM",     paste0("https://www.omim.org/search?search=", g)),
        a_("HGNC",     paste0("https://www.genenames.org/tools/search/#!/?query=", g))
    )
  })
  
  # PHENOTYPE TAB ------------------------------------------------
  term_ids <- reactive({
    id <- req(input$term_sel)
    if (HAS_EDGES && identical(input$term_roll, "yes")) descendants(id) else id
  })
  
  pheno_rows <- reactive(dataset() %>% filter(MondoID %in% term_ids()))
  
  output$pheno_header <- renderUI({
    id <- req(input$term_sel)
    t  <- term_meta %>% filter(MondoID == id)
    d  <- pheno_rows()
    tot <- sum(d$n); plp <- sum(d$n[d$significance == "P/LP"])
    card(div(class = "d-flex justify-content-between flex-wrap gap-3 p-3",
             div(h4(t$term_label, class = "mb-1"),
                 div(class = "note", id, " · ILAE category: ",
                     HTML(age_pill(t$age_cat)))),
             tags$dl(class = "kv mb-0",
                     tags$dt("Genes"),       tags$dd(n_fmt(n_distinct(d$Gene))),
                     tags$dt("Submissions"), tags$dd(n_fmt(tot)),
                     tags$dt("P/LP"),        tags$dd(paste0(n_fmt(plp), " (",
                                                            if (tot) pct(plp / tot) else "—", ")"))
             )
    ))
  })
  
  pheno_summary <- reactive({
    d <- pheno_rows()
    if (!nrow(d)) return(NULL)
    d %>%
      group_by(Gene) %>%
      summarise(Total = sum(n),
                `P/LP` = sum(n[significance == "P/LP"]),
                VUS    = sum(n[significance == "VUS"]),
                `B/LB` = sum(n[significance == "B/LB"]), .groups = "drop") %>%
      left_join(gene_meta %>% select(Gene, clingen_validity, primary_age_cat),
                by = "Gene") %>%
      arrange(desc(Total))
  })
  
  output$p_genes_tbl <- renderDT({
    g <- pheno_summary()
    validate(need(!is.null(g), "No submissions for this term."))
    out <- g %>% transmute(Gene, Total, `P/LP`, VUS, `B/LB`,
                           `ClinGen validity` = clingen_validity,
                           `Primary age category` = age_pill(primary_age_cat))
    epi_table(out, escape = FALSE, page = 15)
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$p_genes_tbl_rows_selected, {
    g <- pheno_summary()$Gene[input$p_genes_tbl_rows_selected]
    updateSelectizeInput(session, "gene_sel", selected = g, server = TRUE,
                         choices = sort(gene_meta$Gene))
    nav_select("nav", "Gene search")
  })
  
  # ABOUT ------------------------------------------------
  output$about <- renderUI({
    tagList(
      div(class = "warnbox mb-4",
          strong("Not for clinical decision-making."), " ",
          "This resource displays variant interpretations as submitted to ClinVar. ",
          "Submissions are not independently validated, are not re-classified here, ",
          "and frequently conflict. The presence of a pathogenic submission is not a ",
          "diagnosis, and its absence is not evidence against a gene–disease relationship."),
      
      h5("What this is"),
      p("An interactive companion to a study of ClinVar variants annotated with Mondo ",
        "Disease Ontology terms corresponding to the epilepsy syndromes of the 2022 ",
        "ILAE classification. It shows every submission in the ClinGen-filtered ",
        "analytic set used in that work: gene–disease pairs curated as Disputed or ",
        "Refuted have already been removed."),
      
      h5("How to read this"),
      p("A ", em("submission"), " is one laboratory's interpretation of one variant for ",
        "one condition. The same variant appears once per submitting laboratory, so ",
        "submission counts measure how much attention a gene has received as much as ",
        "how many distinct variants exist. Variants of uncertain significance dominate ",
        "most genes; this reflects the difficulty of interpretation, not the ",
        "likelihood of disease."),
      p("Age category is a property of the ", em("Mondo term"), " a submitter chose, ",
        "not of any patient. A gene therefore appears under every age category its ",
        "annotated terms belong to."),
      
      h5("Data sources and versions"),
      tags$ul(
        tags$li(paste0("ClinVar, release ", app_meta$clinvar_release)),
        tags$li(paste0("Mondo Disease Ontology ", app_meta$mondo_version)),
        tags$li(paste0("ClinGen / GenCC gene–disease validity, downloaded ",
                       app_meta$clingen_date)),
        tags$li(paste0("gnomAD ", app_meta$gnomad_version, " constraint")),
        tags$li(paste0("ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, queried ", app_meta$trials_date)),
        tags$li(paste0("Application data built ", app_meta$built_on))
      ),
      
      h5("Limitations"),
      p("Fewer than 40% of ClinVar submissions carry a Mondo disease annotation, and ",
        "the annotation rate differs sharply by submitter type, so genes worked on ",
        "mainly by commercial laboratories are systematically under-represented here. ",
        "Gene symbols were resolved against the transcript-based symbol in the ClinVar ",
        "Title field, correcting a substantial number of positional mis-assignments at ",
        "overlapping loci. Clinical trial counts are keyword-based approximations and ",
        "may over- or under-count gene-directed activity."),
      
      h5("Citation"),
      p("The associated manuscript is not yet published. A citation and a ",
        "persistent DOI for this application will be added on publication."),
      
      h5("Contact"),
      p("Corrections, suggested Mondo mappings and other feedback are welcome: ",
        tags$a(APP$contact, href = paste0("mailto:", APP$contact)), "."),
      
      hr(),
      div(class = "note", paste0(APP$title, " ", APP$version, " · built ",
                                 app_meta$built_on))
    )
  })
}

# Reverse a factor's levels so the first category plots at the top.
fct_rev_safe <- function(x) factor(x, levels = rev(levels(x)))

# Walk the Mondo edge list downwards from a term (used only if edges.rds
# is present). Returns the term itself plus every descendant.
descendants <- function(id) {
  out <- id; queue <- id
  while (length(queue)) {
    kids  <- edges$child[edges$parent %in% queue]
    kids  <- setdiff(kids, out)
    out   <- c(out, kids)
    queue <- kids
  }
  out
}

name: global.R
content: library(shiny) library(bslib) library(dplyr) library(tidyr) library(ggplot2) library(DT) library(scales) # 1. CONFIGURATION --------------------------------------------------------- APP <- list( title = "Epilepsy ClinVar", subtitle = "Mondo-defined epilepsy variants", version = "v1.0", doi = NULL, # add when Zenodo is set up repo_url = NULL, # add when Git repo is set up contact = "ivaniuk.alina@mayo.edu" ) # colors AGE_COLS <- c( "Neonatal/infantile onset" = "#8E44AD", "Childhood onset" = "#D96A3A", "Variable onset" = "#2E9E8F", "Not age-specific" = "#4878CF" ) AGE_LEVELS <- names(AGE_COLS) SIG_COLS <- c("P/LP" = "#9B2C2C", "VUS" = "#B7791F", "B/LB" = "#2B6CB0") SIG_LEVELS <- names(SIG_COLS) INK <- list(primary = "#1c1b19", secondary = "#54514c", muted = "#86817a", line = "#e3e1dd", surface = "#fcfcfb") # 2. DATA --------------------------------------------------------- # The app reads the small aggregates built by scripts/prepare_data.R # If they are missing, it builds them from the sample CSV if (!file.exists("app_data/submission_counts.rds")) { message("app_data/ not found — building it from the sample CSV.") source("scripts/prepare_data.R") } submission_counts <- readRDS("app_data/submission_counts.rds") gene_meta <- readRDS("app_data/gene_meta.rds") term_meta <- readRDS("app_data/term_meta.rds") app_meta <- readRDS("app_data/app_meta.rds") # Check if file with edges exists; in case no file exists, no phenotype roll-up HAS_EDGES <- file.exists("app_data/edges.rds") edges <- if (HAS_EDGES) readRDS("app_data/edges.rds") else NULL # Factors assignments (=> colors are fixed) submission_counts <- submission_counts %>% mutate( age_cat = factor(age_cat, levels = AGE_LEVELS), significance = factor(significance, levels = SIG_LEVELS) ) gene_meta <- gene_meta %>% mutate(primary_age_cat = factor(primary_age_cat, levels = AGE_LEVELS)) term_meta <- term_meta %>% mutate(age_cat = factor(age_cat, levels = AGE_LEVELS)) # Choices used by more than one input (for dropdowns) VALIDITY_CHOICES <- sort(unique(na.omit(submission_counts$clingen_validity))) CONSEQUENCE_CHOICES <- sort(unique(na.omit(submission_counts$consequence_class))) VARTYPE_CHOICES <- sort(unique(na.omit(submission_counts$Vartype_grouped))) PATHWAY_CHOICES <- sort(unique(na.omit(gene_meta$pathway))) YEAR_RANGE <- range(submission_counts$SubmissionYear, na.rm = TRUE) # Label shown in the phenotype dropdown: "term name (MONDO:xxxxxxx)" TERM_CHOICES <- setNames(term_meta$MondoID, paste0(term_meta$term_label, " (", term_meta$MondoID, ")")) # 3. HELPERS --------------------------------------------------------- n_fmt <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE) pct <- function(x, d = 1) paste0(formatC(100 * x, format = "f", digits = d), "%") `%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0) b else a # One theme to rule them all theme_epi <- function(base = 12) { theme_minimal(base_size = base) + theme( panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = INK$line, linewidth = 0.3), axis.title = element_text(colour = INK$muted, size = base - 1), axis.text = element_text(colour = INK$secondary), axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"), legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(), legend.text = element_text(colour = INK$secondary, size = base - 1), plot.title = element_blank(), plot.margin = margin(4, 10, 4, 4) ) } # Consistently styled DT. `click_col` makes one column look # clickable; row selection is what the server actually listens to. # DT ref: https://rstudio.github.io/DT/options.html epi_table <- function(df, selection = "single", page = 12, ...) { datatable( df, rownames = FALSE, selection = selection, class = "compact stripe hover", options = list( pageLength = page, lengthChange = FALSE, dom = "ftip", scrollX = TRUE, columnDefs = list(list(className = "dt-right", targets = "_all")) ), ... ) } # Small colored pill used for age categories inside tables and cards, colored same as plot colors age_pill <- function(x) { ifelse(is.na(x), "", sprintf('%s', AGE_COLS[as.character(x)], x)) }
